audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Gus’s friendship speech and Mini-Jukebox gift and Willy’s remedial fishing lesson and Training Rod gift. Every spoken line, culinary metaphor, friendship beat, reward message, crafting instruction, fishing explanation, dialectal phrase, and item term was reviewed in full event context with canonical Mini-Jukebox and Training Rod terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, item and recipe rewards, skill state, runtime gender selector, placeholders, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Together with the preceding batches, all Farm records are covered; the full-locale final audits remain pending.
